title: ⚡️ Turbo Energy Pilots Tokenized Financing for Solar on Stellar $XLM ! ☀️
description:
⚡️ Turbo Energy Pilots Tokenized Financing for Solar on Stellar $XLM ! ☀️

Spain’s Turbo Energy, together with Taurus SA and the Stellar $XLM Development Foundation (SDF), is piloting tokenized debt financing to power the next wave of solar innovation. 🌞

This partnership represents a major step forward for blockchain in green energy, blending sustainability with cutting-edge on-chain finance. 🌍

💬 “We are excited to lead the way in tokenized debt financing for renewable energy infrastructure, unlocking new avenues for investment and sustainability,” — said Luca Marangoni, CEO of Turbo Energy.

The initiative aims to create new liquidity paths for renewable projects and expand Stellar’s ecosystem activity, driving capital into clean energy markets — a sector already worth billions under the Energy-as-a-Service model. ⚙️

While no major governance changes are expected, this pilot could enhance transparency, scalability, and institutional confidence in green blockchain finance. 🌱

With Stellar $XLM at its core, this project pushes the boundaries of how real-world assets meet decentralized technology — turning solar power into tokenized opportunity. ⚡️
